description: Run the rendered-tier design checks (r-*): kicker size, gradient text, tracked caps, glued arrows, marquee, hidden reveal, fold budget, screen word budget, section rhythm, fake progress, and WCAG contrast — all pure functions over a computed snapshot ({elements:[...]}, see src/render-checks.js). Pass an object snapshot; no browser needed.

snapshot.description: computed snapshot: { viewport?, documentStyle?, elements: [...], screens? }

url.description: http(s) URL to collect then check (requires the optional playwright collector)

name: scan_render
